Account: Elmbridge Support Assurance (payment processor for healthcare providers). Heavy compliance (PCI + PHI) — require BAA and PCI DSS attestation. Cost sensitivity: high — wants recommendations from Redwood Optimize on batching & quantization before committing to Dedicated.

Client quote: "If PHI touches the agent suggestion, we need full audit trail and ability to withdraw data within 24h."
